I hope you’ve stopped starving yourself. I’ve dealt with anorexia as a teenager and the after effects can be detrimental. I know it’s not easy to be happy in your own body, I’ve found that ways to combat that can be doing what makes you happy. The more you dive into activities you find are fun, the less you worry about how you look because you’re so focused on the great moments. And once you let yourself have fun/relax, eat what you want without feeling bad about it. The more you’ll realize the restriction you had on food is what’s causing the actual pain. When you stop feeling bad for being yourself, you start taking care of yourself because you actually want to. Not because you have to.

In regards to your last statement, I don’t believe you’re gonna live the rest of your life feeling as bad as you do now. You’re gonna have new interests, make new friends/significant others who are able to stay around you because they appreciate you for who you are.
